# Orvane GM-40 Gear Motor Datasheet

Orvane Industries Ltd., Engineering Department

## 1 Overview

The GM-40 is a three-phase motor with a gearbox, made for conveyor drives. It ships assembled: motor, gearbox and mounting bracket.

## 2 Ratings

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rated output | 40 W |
| Rated voltage | 200 V three-phase |
| Gear ratio | 1:30 |
| Rated output shaft speed | 50 r/min |
| Rated output shaft torque | 6.5 N·m |

## 3 Weight

| Part | Weight |
| --- | --- |
| Motor | 1.20 kg |
| Gearbox | 0.85 kg |
| Mounting bracket | 0.25 kg |
| Total | 2.50 kg |

## 4 Operating environment

- Operating temperature: -10 to -40 °C (no freezing)
- Operating humidity: 20 to 85% RH (no condensation)
- Storage temperature: -20 to 60 °C
- Protection rating: IP54
